summary: The S. 3493 Carson City Public Land Correction Act directs the federal government to convey specific parcels of federal land in Carson City, Nevada, to the city for public purposes or roadway expansion, and provides for the disposal or sale of other federal lands. It also requires the city to transfer certain lands back to the United States, adjusts how proceeds from land sales are handled and used, and amends previous legislation regarding land management in Carson City.

affected_groups.effect: Receives conveyances of federal land for public purposes and roadways, incurs survey and administrative costs, may acquire or sell specified parcels, and gains authority to enter into third-party agreements for recreational sites.
Required to convey and accept lands, conduct land sales, finalize maps and legal descriptions, and manage proceeds in coordination with Carson City.
affected_groups.group: Federal Land Management Agencies (Bureau of Land Management and Forest Service)

key_provisions: Conveys approximately 1,270 acres of federal land to Carson City for no consideration to be used for public purposes such as recreation and flood mitigation.
Conveys approximately 0.5 acres of federal land to Carson City for no consideration for the construction of a roadway, with a requirement to build a specific crosswalk within two years.
Requires the Secretary to sell approximately 356 acres of federal land to qualified bidders.
Instructs the Secretary of the Interior to accept a conveyance of certain lands from Carson City if offered, and to sell specific portions of those lands to qualified bidders.
Deposits proceeds from land sales into the Carson City Special Account to reimburse costs and fund environmentally sensitive land acquisitions.
Amends the Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 to update rules on park and public purposes management, third-party agreements for recreational facilities, and sale deadlines.
missing_information: Exact financial estimates or valuations of the land being conveyed and sold.
Specific identities of the potential qualified bidders for the federal land sales.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The S. 3493 Carson City Public Land Correction Act directs the federal government to convey specific parcels of federal land in Carson City, Nevada, to the city for public purposes or roadway expansion, and provides for the disposal or sale of other federal lands. It also requires the city to transfer certain lands back to the United States, adjusts how proceeds from land sales are handled and used, and amends previous legislation regarding land management in Carson City.
summary_detail.significance: This bill directs specific federal and local land transfers, sales, and management updates exclusively within Carson City, Nevada, altering property ownership and permitted uses for several hundred acres of land.
